Name: Zandatsu
Description: Free-angle slicing: enemies are cut along the real plane of your sword swing, like Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance. The cut enemy stays a corpse you can cut again; lose only a limb and he fights on and bleeds out. Cut his sword and shield too. A fire-imbued blade sears the cut.
Author: StainlessHalo (built with Claude Code)
